title: Roman Catholic Popes Dataset
description: A structured, open dataset of Roman Catholic popes, canonical pontificate records, and separate antipope records.
modeling_notes: Canonical person records and pontificate records are separate.
Benedict IX appears once as a person and three times as pontificate records.
Benedict X is modeled as an antipope, not as a canonical pope.
Pope-elect Stephen is not included as a canonical pope.
Antipopes are kept in a separate dataset.
